## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -12.84%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and Stocks vs Bonds (1W: +2.15% | 1M: +2.64%) ↑ rising with SPY (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +1.95%) ABOVE TREND; offset risk: HYG/LQD shows credit stress ↑ rising with HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.73%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.69% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -12.84%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit stress creeping: HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.73%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.69% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION — HYG/LQD signaling stress ↑ rising. Stocks-bonds tilt supportive: SPY (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +1.95%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: -1.20% | 1M: +0.22%) CORRECTION → falling.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar firm: Dollar Strength (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +1.25%) → flat | ABOVE TREND. Yield tone marginally tighter with TLT (1W: -1.20% | 1M: +0.22%) CORRECTION ↓ falling and yield curve (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -0.63%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Financials and Healthcare are leaders: XLF (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +6.71%) ABOVE TREND. Tech under short-term pressure: XLK (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.76%) CORRECTION — style: cyclical/value tilt emerging as financials outperform tech.

5. US vs Global?
US marginally stronger: SPY (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +1.95%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +2.09%) ABOVE TREND shows EM participation; China catching a bounce: FXI (1W: +4.50% | 1M: -2.94%) RECOVERY but Europe lagging: Europe vs US ↓ falling and region below trend.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation mixed but intact: IBIT (1W: +5.32% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY and XBI (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +28.04%) ABOVE TREND show risk-on flows, while ARKK (1W: -0.39% | 1M: +7.45%) CORRECTION signals some thematic pullbacks.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Metals mixed: GLD (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -4.81%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +1.05% | 1M: -12.08%) RECOVERY on short-term bids; copper CPER (1W: +1.45% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY — watch for follow-through into industrials.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy showing strength but uneven: XLE (1W: +3.81% | 1M: -5.34%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +7.00% | 1M: -18.73%) RECOVERY on reflation headlines, while natural gas UNG (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -4.75%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Financials XLF (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND and broad sector breadth (7/11) support RISK-ON. DIVERGENCE: Major divergence present — XLK (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.76%) CORRECTION, QQQ (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +1.12%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -1.20% | 1M: +0.22%) CORRECTION show 1W/1M mismatches; treat momentum as conditional.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/financials exposure: XLF (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +28.04%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength; reduce exposure to tech momentum where XLK (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.76%) CORRECTION signals short-term fatigue.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +28.04%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND — watch momentum continuation. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.76%) CORRECTION and Materials XME (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -12.88%) BELOW TREND if commodity weakness persists.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +7.00% | 1M: -18.73%) RECOVERY — oil volatility could drive cyclicals. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -4.75%) BELOW TREND — gas weakness to pressure energy peers sensitive to gas.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) with VXX (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -12.84%) BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD ~0.80 as a credit health pivot with HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.73%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.69% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION; XLK/XLF ratio near a rotation point with XLK (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.76%) CORRECTION and XLF (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-ON. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive with VXX (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -12.84%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and SPY (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +1.95%) ABOVE TREND confirming risk appetite. Financials and biotech showing relative strength — XLF (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +28.04%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: rising credit stress (HYG vs LQD) and major 1W/1M divergences in tech and duration to monitor.
